"typescriptCustomType" : "class Street {\n    #doors: number[];\n    #cur_index: number = 0;\n\n    constructor(doors: number[]) {\n        this.#doors = doors;\n    }\n\n    public openDoor(): void {\n        this.#doors[this.#cur_index] = 1;\n    }\n\n    public closeDoor(): void {\n        this.#doors[this.#cur_index] = 0;\n    }\n\n    public isDoorOpen(): boolean {\n        return this.#doors[this.#cur_index] !== 0;\n    }\n\n    public moveLeft(): void {\n        this.#cur_index--;\n        while (this.#cur_index < 0) {\n            this.#cur_index += this.#doors.length;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public moveRight(): void {\n        this.#cur_index++;\n        this.#cur_index %= this.#doors.length;\n    }\n}\n"
